dedupe_keys.name: windse wind farm simulation and optimisation

description: WindSE is the national-laboratory Python package for wind-farm simulation and optimisation using FEniCS. It contains configurable flow domains, turbine arrangements and solution or optimisation settings. YAML input files describe the mesh, terrain, boundary conditions and turbines; outputs include solution fields, turbine forces and meshes in PVD or XDMF formats. Coverage is a user-defined wind-farm domain, with steady or time-dependent settings chosen for the experiment. Source is free under Apache-2.0, confirmed in the repository licence. A limitation is that the documented environment was tested on older macOS and Linux versions and Windows is not recommended. Some boundary-condition options are marked incomplete. WindSE supports wind-infrastructure layout and performance simulations. Kynema-SGF (model-kynema-sgf) is a related wind-flow model. The parameter documentation was inspected; no solver, package or model archive was installed.
